financials_multi_year.source: First HoldCo Plc FY2025 Audited Financial Statements (NGX), read 24-Nov-26

observations.notes: FY25 assets NGN 27.25tn, net loans NGN 8.97tn, deposits NGN 18.88tn, NII NGN 1,916.9bn, PBT NGN 235.0bn, PAT NGN 139.5bn after heavy risk-reserve deductions post-CBN forbearance expiry; CAR dipped to 10.95% at YE25.

financials_multi_year.source: First HoldCo Plc 9M 2026 Financial Statements (NGX), read 24-Nov-26

observations.notes: 9M26 assets NGN 32.20tn (+18% YTD), net loans NGN 9.39tn, deposits NGN 22.91tn, NII NGN 1.26tn, PBT NGN 911.24bn, PAT NGN 744.45bn. Flagship FirstBank restored CAR to 16.7% by mid-2026 (~170bp above 15% CBN minimum), prompting S&P CreditWatch resolution.

debt_maturities.source: Redeemed $350m 8.625% Oct-2025 Eurobond (XS2243733685) in full; ongoing funding anchored by NGN 22.91tn deposit base and recapitalisation.

verdict.stance: Constructive / Tier-1 Nigerian Bank Turnaround Post-CAR Restoration (B/B)
verdict.summary: First HoldCo staged a decisive 2026 capital and earnings recovery: 9M26 PAT surged to NGN 744.45bn (vs NGN 139.5bn FY25) while flagship FirstBank restored CAR to 16.7% (~170bp above the 15% CBN floor) after dipping to 10.95% at YE25 on oil/gas forbearance exits. Redeemed its $350m Oct-25 Eurobond in full; NGN 22.91tn deposit franchise anchors liquidity.

positives: CAR remediated to 16.7% by mid-2026 (from 10.95% YE25), clearing S&P CreditWatch Negative.
Strong 9M26 earnings rebound: PBT NGN 911.24bn, PAT NGN 744.45bn, deposits NGN 22.91tn.
Clean external debt track record: $350m 8.625% Oct-2025 Eurobond (XS2243733685) redeemed on schedule.
negatives: Residual NPL cleanup and oil & gas asset quality sensitivity following CBN forbearance expiration.
CBN cash reserve requirement (CRR) tightening and NGN/FX translation volatility.
Sovereign linkage to Nigeria (B) and potential dilution/capital deployment needs for CBN NGN 500bn minimum paid-up capital rule.

background.business_overview: Nigeria's oldest Tier-1 banking group (First Bank of Nigeria Limited, FBNQuest) operating retail, corporate, and commercial banking across Nigeria and West Africa/UK.
background.asset_perimeter: FirstBank Nigeria, FirstBank UK, FBNBank subsidiaries across SSA, FBNQuest merchant banking/asset management.
background.ownership_governance: Listed on NGX (FIRSTHOLDCO, ISIN NGFBNH000009); regulated by CBN.

Mid-2026: Flagship FirstBank restored CAR to 16.7% (+170bp over 15% CBN threshold); S&P updated CreditWatch Negative assessment.
